properties_note: Named C64 property bytes; packed fields retain all bits. See docs/item-and-monster-fields.md. Zero damage bytes are dice encodings, not absence of damage; melee_damage is only exposed for weapons.

field_notes.maximum_charges: 255 means unlimited/nondepleting; finite loot charges may be randomized; zero remains raw
field_notes.armor_and_damage_bonus: low nibble AC reduction; high nibble melee damage bonus
field_notes.type_and_attack_effect: low nibble item category; high nibble attack effect code
field_notes.usable_classes_mask: shared class bits; tested against class-mask table at $d987, not one bit per class
field_notes.equipped_effect: low nibble equipped-effect selector; upper bits retained, unresolved
field_notes.use_effect_id: spell/special-use effect ID; 255 is no use effect
